```yaml
name: Auto-approve Copilot PRs

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

permissions:
  pull-requests: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  auto-approve:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.actor == 'github-copilot' || github.actor == 'github-copilot[bot]'
    steps:
      - name: Auto-approve Copilot PR
        uses: hmarr/auto-approve-action@v3
```
